strings.name: Justin Yifu Lin
strings.summary: After military service in Taiwan, Lin moved to mainland China in 1979 and completed degrees at Peking and Chicago. He helped establish the China Center for Economic Research and served as World Bank chief economist from 2008 to 2012. He advocates New Structural Economics, studying industries, comparative advantage and government, and continued research, teaching and development-policy discussion at Peking University.
